prerequisites: Basic knowledge of involute gears and transmissions is required.

learning_outcomes.text: Building on the knowledge of involute gear transmissions, the student expands their knowledge of other gear geometries.
Students can understand and analyze the application of spur gears in more complex contexts.
Students can verify and question various concepts in the context of the drivetrain.
Students create a design for a transmission consisting of concepts, design, and a digital model.
Students work in groups to develop solutions for scientific problems and present the results with the help of meaningful documents.

syllabus_topics: simple epicyclic gears with linear transmission function

assessment_methods.method: Homework (construction of 1-2 gearboxes, including all calculations and documents)
